one_liner: Jarrett Allen converts 65.9 percent of his field goals and 12 rebounds per 36 minutes -- rim volume with no perimeter component.
three_things: 65.9 percent from the field, one of the highest conversion rates in the atlas.
12 rebounds per 36 backs the interior role.
The three-point number, 4.8 percent, confirms the shot chart never leaves the paint.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
